	private static List<CoreDatatype> coreDatatypes() {
		var result = new ArrayList<CoreDatatype>();
		result.addAll(List.of(CoreDatatype.XSD.values()));
		result.addAll(List.of(CoreDatatype.RDF.values()));
		result.addAll(List.of(CoreDatatype.GEO.values()));
		return result;
	}

	private static Literal coreLiteral(CoreDatatype datatype) {
		if (datatype == CoreDatatype.RDF.LANGSTRING) { return VF.createLiteral("dictionary:LANGSTRING", "en"); }
		if (datatype == CoreDatatype.RDF.DIRLANGSTRING) {
			return VF.createLiteral("dictionary:DIRLANGSTRING", "en", Literal.BaseDirection.LTR);
		}
		return VF.createLiteral("dictionary:" + datatype, datatype);
	}

	private static void recordLiteral(Properties properties, String prefix, Literal literal, ValueStore values)
			throws Exception {
		properties.setProperty(prefix + ".id", Long.toString(values.getId(literal)));
		properties.setProperty(prefix + ".label", literal.getLabel());
		properties.setProperty(prefix + ".datatype", literal.getDatatype().stringValue());
		properties.setProperty(prefix + ".language", literal.getLanguage().orElse(""));
		properties.setProperty(prefix + ".direction", literal.getBaseDirection() == null ? "" : literal.getBaseDirection().name());
	}

	private static Value expiredTerm() {
		return VF.createTripleTerm(VF.createIRI("urn:v6:expired-component"),
				VF.createIRI("urn:v6:expired-predicate"), VF.createLiteral("expired component"));
	}

	private static Value standaloneTerm() {
		return VF.createTripleTerm(VF.createIRI("urn:v6:standalone"), PREDICATE,
				VF.createLiteral("standalone dictionary component"));
	}
